description: This file defines a Windows service for running the OpenERP server, including service control methods, process management, and integration with Windows service manager.

classes.name: OpenERPServerService
classes.description: A Windows service class that manages starting, stopping, and monitoring the OpenERP server process.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the service, sets up process handle and stop event.

methods.name: SvcStop
methods.description: Handles stopping the service and terminating the server process.

methods.name: StartTERP
methods.description: Starts the OpenERP server process as a subprocess.

methods.name: SvcDoRun
methods.description: Main execution method that starts the server and waits for stop signal.
